Italian Americans in the American Civil.question: On March 19, 1861, the “_____” paraded through the streets of New Orleans, in uniforms that recalled the Garibaldi volunteers of Italy, red jacket and tricolor cockade
Italian Americans in the American Civil.fact: The Italians already present in Louisiana attempted to form a battalion, called the "Garibaldi Legion" or, alternatively, "Garibaldi Guards": about 170 Italians volunteered. On February 21, 1861, the "first company of the Garibaldi Guards" or simply "Garibaldi Guards" was prepared and fully equipped.

Italian Americans in the American Civil.question: Bernard Parish, _____ established in 1747 by her grandfather Francesco Maria de Reggio, an Italian nobleman of the House of Este
Italian Americans in the American Civil.fact: General P. G. T. Beauregard, a Louisiana Creole, had Italian ancestry via his mother Hélène Judith de Reggio, who hailed from a prominent first family of St. Bernard Parish, Louisiana set up in 1747 by her grandfather Francesco Maria de Reggio, an Italian nobleman of the House of Este.
